name: IFX Rio de Piedras
notes: Data Center Map lists IFX Rio de Piedras at 21 Avenida, 7 Calle, San Pedro Sula, with colocation/cloud services and Uptime Tier III design-standard description; IFX contact page confirms Rio Piedras San Pedro Sula office/address.

name: Banco Central de Honduras Centro de Cómputo Alterno
notes: Uptime Institute lists BCH Centro de Cómputo Alterno in San Pedro Sula with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; HonduCompras records reference the alternate computing center at the BCH San Pedro Sula branch.

name: Grupo POPA San Pedro Sula Data Center
developer: Grupo POPA / International Technology Group S.A.
notes: Datacenters.com lists a Grupo POPA San Pedro Sula colocation data center in Cortés; Grupo POPA's site confirms its ITG data-center services business, though the official page does not give this facility-level address.

name: Tigo Data Center Evolution Phase 1
developer: Telefónica Celular S.A. / Tigo Honduras / Millicom
notes: Tigo help page places Data Center Evolution in Parque Empresarial Periférico, Tegucigalpa, AMDC, Francisco Morazán, on a 4,223 m2 site; first phase had 585 m2 data-center area and 1,575 m2 total construction. Uptime lists TIGO Honduras Phase 1 with Tier III design certification.

name: Honduras Tigo Data Center Evolution Phases 2A and 2B
developer: Telefónica Celular S.A. / Tigo Honduras / Millicom
notes: Uptime Institute awards list identifies Honduras Tigo Data Center Evolution, Phases 2A and 2B, Tegucigalpa, with Tier III Certification of Design Documents; BNamericas reported the same as a data-center expansion design certification in July 2026.

name: Navégalo Honduras-Tegucigalpa Data Center
notes: Navégalo official location page describes Honduras data-center-backed infrastructure services for Tegucigalpa/San Pedro Sula and regional interconnection; Baxtel lists Navegalo Honduras-Tegucigalpa, year built 2015, in Tegucigalpa with Tier III design infrastructure and colocation/cloud services.

name: IFX Elvel
notes: Data Center Map lists IFX Elvel at Tercer nivel, Colonia Altos del Miramonte, Sector 11, Tegucigalpa, with colocation/cloud services and Uptime Tier III design-standard description; IFX contact page confirms the Tegucigalpa office/address.

name: BAC-Credomatic CPP Honduras
notes: Uptime Institute lists BAC-Credomatic CPP Honduras in Tegucigalpa with Tier III Certification of Design Documents and Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility.

name: Banco Central de Honduras Centro de Computo Primario
notes: Uptime Institute lists BCH Centro de Computo Primario in Tegucigalpa MDC, Francisco Morazan, with Tier III Certification of Design Documents and Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility.

name: Cable Color Smart Data Center / Data Center Cable Color
notes: La Tribuna reported Cable Color's October 2020 launch of Smart Data Center in Tegucigalpa, a Tier II class colocation/cross-connect service; Datacenters.com lists the facility in Tegucigalpa, Francisco Morazán.

name: Grupo POPA Tegucigalpa Data Center
developer: Grupo POPA / International Technology Group S.A.
notes: Grupo POPA says it entered data-center services in 2008 and inaugurated in July 2009 the first Tier 2 data center with Tier 3 characteristics in Honduras, offering hosting, colocation, storage, IaaS, and tape custody. Datacenters.com lists the Grupo POPA Tegucigalpa facility in Francisco Morazán.
